verdict.rationale: Clerky documents a Partner API on developers.clerky.com, with lifecycle docs that link endpoints such as POST /v1/document_sets. Nothing in the evidence shows an interactive reference, a try-it console or runnable examples. Authentication is still 'coming soon', so requests cannot currently be run, and the OpenAPI probes on the handbooks domain all returned 404. A static reference is adjacent to the story, not delivery of it.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
